title: [29.X]-[Subcontracting] Purchase Return Order cannot be posted for subcontracting, while Corrective Credit Memo works well
summary: Fixed an issue where purchase return orders could not be posted for subcontracting operations, while corrective credit memos worked correctly.
key_points: Purchase return orders for subcontracting can now be posted successfully
Aligns behavior between purchase return orders and corrective credit memos
Modified manufacturing purchase document management logic
Added test coverage for Belgium, Italy, and W1 regions
